verdict.rationale: Lambda exposes a full REST API for creating/managing instances programmatically, supports cloud-init for launch-time automation, and instances are accessible via SSH (not just GUI), all of which support headless/CI use; community evidence even shows a third-party CLI/MCP wrapper enabling AI agents to launch and run jobs unattended. Missing for 10: an official first-party CLI/SDK, explicit CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions) integration docs, and confirmation of idempotent/automatable teardown (the community billing incident shows no auto-stop, a gap for CI cost control).
